answer:
Use the classic 2D dam-break benchmark with a 0.5 m by 0.5 m closed box.
Place a 0.25 m by 0.25 m water column in the bottom-left corner.
Create a uniform 50 by 50 mesh in the x-y plane and extrude it one cell in z.
Set the z-extruded patches to empty and name them frontAndBack.
Set the left, right, top, and bottom patches as walls.
Apply noSlip to U on all wall boundaries.
Apply fixedFluxPressure with uniform value 0 to p_rgh on all wall boundaries.
Apply zeroGradient to alpha.water on all wall boundaries.
Initialize U to uniform (0 0 0).
Initialize p_rgh to uniform 0.
Initialize alpha.water with setFields so that alpha.water is 1 in the region x=0..0.25 and y=0..0.25 and 0 elsewhere.
Set gravity to (0 -9.81 0).
Set interFoam phase properties with water rho 1000 and nu 1e-6 and air rho 1 and nu 1.48e-5 and sigma 0.07.
In system/controlDict set application to interFoam.
Run setFields before interFoam.
Run the simulation until endTime 0.5 s.
Use adjustable time stepping with maxCo 0.5 and maxAlphaCo 0.5.
Write results at regular intervals of 0.01 s.
